CSS Pattern Generator

Build CSS background patterns — dots, stripes, checker, zigzag and grid — with your colors and size, live preview, and copyable CSS.

📖 How to use

      
  1. Pick a pattern type (dots, stripes, checker, zigzag, grid).
  2. Choose the foreground and background colors plus tile size.
  3. Preview the pattern live.
  4. Click "Copy CSS" and paste it into your stylesheet.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Are the patterns seamless and sharp?
The patterns are built from layered CSS gradients, so they tile perfectly and stay sharp at any zoom.
Can I combine a pattern with a gradient?
Yes — the snippet is just a background declaration you can layer over or under other backgrounds.
How do I use two patterns together?
Copy the snippet again with a different size or color and apply it to another element, or use multiple background layers.
